  • The Polling Problem, and What a WebSocket Is

    Every HTTP request is the client asking first — a WebSocket is one connection either side can push through, at any moment, with no request to answer.

    Why reach for a library at all instead of the raw WebSocket API — fallbacks, reconnection, and rooms, all needed here anyway.

  • Authenticating a Socket with the Existing JWT

    A connection isn't 'anyone' until it hands over the same JWT it already carries for HTTP requests — then it joins a room or two.

    notifyRealtime.listener.js sends the same four domain events to whichever room each one is relevant to, wired up from server.js.
